context_requirements: Intact NRF2-KEAP1 signaling for antioxidant response
Functional ATF4/ISR pathway for amino acid and redox homeostasis
p53 pathway for some late apoptotic and cell-cycle responses
falsifiers: No induction of NRF2 target genes (HMOX1, NQO1, TXNRD1) at 6 h in any line
No increase in oxidative stress or apoptosis markers at 24 h
Predominant upregulation of cholesterol synthesis genes instead of downregulation
No difference in response between lines with intact versus defective NRF2 signaling
Transcriptional profile indistinguishable from vehicle at both time points

evidence.supports: Oxidative stress inducer menadione triggers apoptosis via Fas/FasL, linking oxidative stress to death receptor signaling
Sodium iodate, an oxidative stress inducer, causes lysosomal dysfunction and autophagic flux impairment
H2O2-induced oxidative stress increases autophagy markers and ROS in intestinal epithelial cells
3-nitropropanoic acid as oxidative stress inducer promotes copper accumulation and cuproptosis in granulosa cells
Oxidative stress in osteosarcoma cells induces NRF2 synthesis and cytoprotective programs
